preamble: Extreme macro photography, 100mm macro lens. Razor-thin plane of focus, everything else falling to soft darkness. Backlit so edges glow. Visible surface texture and grain of the material. Deep negative space. Photographic realism, no CGI, no illustration, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A lush hand-tied bouquet of powder-pink garden roses, white ranunculus and eucalyptus wrapped in plain brown kraft paper, standing upright on a dark green-black wooden table, seen from slightly above at a three-quarter angle. Backlit from behind right so the petal edges and the paper edge glow; the rest of the frame falls into deep forest-green darkness. The bouquet occupies the lower right third of the frame; the upper left two thirds of the frame are empty soft darkness for text. No people, no hands, no text, no card, no lettering on the paper, no logos, no watermark.
